meta.name: content-research-writer
meta.description: 内容创作者、技术写作员在撰写博客、深度文章或技术文档时，使用此技能可开启全流程写作协作。它能帮你研究资料、构建大纲、逐段打磨并自动添加引用，快速优化Hook，让你高效产出高质量内容，告别孤军奋战！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 产出带引用、逐段打磨的内容作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写长文时总是卡在资料整理和打磨上
copy.tagline_en: Research, structure, and polish articles with citations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get stuck on research and polishing when writing long articles.

howto.what: Claude 会变成你的写作搭档：帮你搭大纲、查资料并按你选的格式加引用、改写开头 Hook、逐节给反馈，同时尽量保留你的语气，产出大纲、研究笔记和全文审阅清单。
howto.when: 当你要写博客、深度文章或技术文档，需要查资料、加引用、优化开头或逐节反馈时触发。

say.text: 帮我为一篇关于[主题]的文章搭个大纲
say.note: 它会先问你受众、篇幅和写作目标

say.text: 这是我的开头，帮我把 Hook 改得更有吸引力
say.note: 它会分析现有开头并给出多个改写方案

say.text: 我刚写完“为什么重要”这一节，帮我审一下
say.note: 它会列出优点和具体修改建议

howto.what_en: Claude becomes your writing partner: it builds outlines, researches and adds formatted citations, rewrites your hook, gives section-by-section feedback and keeps your voice, producing outlines, research notes and a full-draft review.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you write blog posts, deep articles or technical docs and need research, citations, a stronger hook or section-by-section feedback.

say_en.text: Help me create an outline for an article about [topic]
say_en.note: It first asks about audience, length and goal

say_en.text: Here's my intro; help me make the hook more compelling
say_en.note: It analyzes it and offers several rewrites

say_en.text: I just finished the 'Why This Matters' section. Review it.
say_en.note: It lists strengths and specific suggestions
